LESSON: HYGIENE IN REARING ANIMALS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: GRADE
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin
Topic 3.1: Hygiene in rearing animals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hygiene in rearing animals, part of HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How can we maintain hygiene while rearing animals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hygiene in rearing animals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: Engaging in assigned roles while carrying out hygiene practices in rearing domestic animals.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Animal welfare as learners observe hygiene practices in rearing domestic animals.

Link to other subjects: Learners relate hygiene practices in rearing domestic animals to concepts of animal production as an
